_note: M2W1: the shot list of tools/m2w1_capture.gd (the world-art audit captures of alesia_1km). Read by that tool only; nothing in the game reads it. Coordinates are world metres (x, z; y = metres above the terrain under the point). cam = the camera's ground point; eye_m = the camera's height above the terrain there (default 1.7, a standing soldier's eye); look = [x, y above the terrain under (x, z), z]; fov = vertical degrees (default: the game camera's at the window's aspect, data/camera.json fov_table); soldier = one standing soldier (the normal pawn model) 6 m in front of the camera on the ground (or at soldier_at [x, z]), facing the camera. look_mode sun / antisun: look horizontally towards / away from the variant's sun, pitch_deg up (look is ignored). Names start with a number so the files sort in shot order.
